cards.title: What the probe found (herdr 0.9.1 client, 0.9.0 server)
items: An outside report-agent --state blocked never changes a Claude pane's state: idle or working, any source, with or without the session id
herdr agent explain shows why: Claude's state comes only from herdr's screen-detection rules
On a pane with no detected agent the same report shows as agent sdlc, state blocked; release-agent clears it
The tree pane is such a pane, and the notify command inherits its HERDR_PANE_ID: the hook needs no other pane's id

cards.title: Features (strike what you don't want)
items: 1. Seat flag: at each arrival the tree pane shows in herdr's sidebar as agent sdlc, state blocked, with the approval and the unit
2. The flag clears once the pane's first line stops reading waiting on a seat, and on Ctrl-C; a different seat's hook keeps its own flag
3. Toast: waiting on a seat, the approval and the unit, the request sound
4. One key opens the pane (a herdr plugin action). Recommended: strike for now
5. The config line: tree: notify: python E:/herdr-sdlc/herdr_seat.py in the kit's .sdlc/config.yaml, a free path

cards.title: Decisions for you (three)
items: 1. The features: keep 1, 2, 3 and 5; strike 4. Recommended
2. Placement: a new local repo, E:/herdr-sdlc, with the script, its tests and a README; no GitHub remote until you ask
3. Delegation as in session 42: Workflow subagents build and verify; Claude approves the test list and the commit; you approve the push and the PR

cards.title: Glossary
items: t8's notify: the tree: notify: command in .sdlc/config.yaml, run through the shell once per arrival at an approval, with the task's id in SDLC_NODE
Seat: the human who approves; the pane's first line reads waiting on a seat: <approval> for <unit>
Free path: a path the kit's scope check lets change without a contract (.sdlc/, plan.md, STATE.md and more)
Two-Key: an independent verifier re-runs every check and grades the work; no code is done before its PASS
